text.en: The phoneme /r/ is a voiced alveolar tap [ɾ], though in the speech of some speakers it is occasionally realized as an alveolar trill [r] ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--the-phoneme-r-is-a-voiced-alveolar-tap⟧. Many consonants contrast in syllable-coda position in Ainu, and the tap /r/ in particular occurs there ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--many-consonants-contrast-in-syllable-coda-position-in⟧. The rhotic r approaches *d* after *n*, becomes voiceless after *k* and *p*, becomes a voiceless fricative after *t* and *sh*, and varies according to the preceding vowel in coda position ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--the-rhotic-r-is-an-alveolar-tap-that⟧.
text.ja: 音素/r/は有声歯茎弾き音[ɾ]であるが、一部の話者の発話では時に歯茎ふるえ音[r]として実現する⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--the-phoneme-r-is-a-voiced-alveolar-tap⟧。アイヌ語では音節末で多くの子音が対立し、特に弾き音/r/が現われる⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--many-consonants-contrast-in-syllable-coda-position-in⟧。流音rはnの後ではdに近づき、k・pの後では無声のrとなり、t・shの後では無声摩擦のrとなり、音節末では直前の母音に応じて異なる響きを示す⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--the-rhotic-r-is-an-alveolar-tap-that⟧。

text.en: The phoneme /r/ is realized as a flap [ɾ] intervocalically, and in syllable-final position it is frequently followed by a non-phonemic off-glide vowel echoing the preceding vowel ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--coda-r-nonphonemic-offglide-vowel⟧. This echo vowel often sounds like a schwa [ə] ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--after-a-syllable-final-r-the-preceding-vowel⟧. Because coda *r* is an instantaneous tap, the preceding vowel is heard at the end of the syllable: *kar* sounds like *karᵃ*, *kir* like *kirⁱ*, *kur* like *kurᵘ*, *ker* like *kerᵉ*, and *kor* like *korᵒ* ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--because-coda-r-is-an-instantaneous-tap-an⟧. More precisely, as the vocal folds continue vibrating after the tongue tip taps the alveolar ridge and the tongue restores a posture close to the preceding vowel, an echo-like vowel is repeated before the next syllable begins ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-syllable-final-r-as-the-vocal-folds⟧. Syllable-final *r* is thus frequently a tap [ɾ] followed by such an echo vowel, though in some speakers or cases a trill may appear instead ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--syllable-final-r-is-frequently-a-tap-followed⟧. In Hokkaido Ainu, however, the presence or absence of a vowel immediately after /r/ is phonologically clearly distinguished, so that the syllable remains closed ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-hokkaido-ainu-syllable-final-r-is-a⟧. Ainu possesses syllable-final *-r* in words such as *kor* 'to have', *kar* 'to make', and *mokor* 'to sleep' ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--ainu-possesses-syllable-final-r-in-words-such⟧. In singing or with emphatic intonation, an overt vowel may clearly appear after /-r/, as in [piri:ka] ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-singing-or-with-emphatic-intonation-an-overt⟧.
text.ja: 音素/r/は母音間で弾き音[ɾ]として実現し、音節末では先行母音を反映した非音素的な渡り母音を伴うことが多い⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--coda-r-nonphonemic-offglide-vowel⟧。この渡り母音はしばしばシュワー[ə]のように聞こえる⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--after-a-syllable-final-r-the-preceding-vowel⟧。音節末のrは舌尖が一度接触して離れるだけの音であるため、先行母音の余韻が聞こえ、karはkarᵃ、kirはkirⁱ、kurはkurᵘ、kerはkerᵉ、korはkorᵒのように響く⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--because-coda-r-is-an-instantaneous-tap-an⟧。より詳しくは、舌先が歯茎を叩いた後も声帯の振動が続き、舌全体が直前の母音に近い構えを回復する間に、次の音節に移る前に直前の母音に類似した母音が繰り返される⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-syllable-final-r-as-the-vocal-folds⟧。音節末のrはこのように弾き音[ɾ]の後に渡り母音を伴うことが多いが、話者や場合によってはふるえ音が現れることもある⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--syllable-final-r-is-frequently-a-tap-followed⟧。ただし北海道アイヌ語では、/r/の直後に母音があるかないかは音韻的にはっきり区別され、閉音節を形成する⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-hokkaido-ainu-syllable-final-r-is-a⟧。アイヌ語にはkor「持つ」・kar「造る」・mokor「眠る」などの語において音節末のrが存在する⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--ainu-possesses-syllable-final-r-in-words-such⟧。歌の中や強調的なイントネーションを伴う場合には、[piri:ka]のように/-r/の後に明らかな母音が出現することがある⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-singing-or-with-emphatic-intonation-an-overt⟧。

text.en: The flap [r] devoices after [k] and [p], devoices and exhibits slight frication after [t], and is devoiced and completely fricated after [ʃ] ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--the-flap-r-devoices-after-k-and-p⟧.
text.ja: 弾音[r]は[k]および[p]の後で無声化し、[t]の後では無声化するとともにわずかな摩擦を帯び、[ʃ]の後では無声化して完全に摩擦音化する⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--the-flap-r-devoices-after-k-and-p⟧。

text.en: Sakhalin Ainu shows distinct reflexes of coda /r/ that differ from Hokkaido Ainu. In Sakhalin Ainu, the identical vowel is inserted immediately after /r/, creating an open syllable with no phonological distinction from an open syllable, though in some words /h/ replaces the consonant instead of the *+rV* pattern ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-sakhalin-ainu-the-identical-vowel-is-inserted⟧. More generally, word-final /r/ in Sakhalin Ainu has become either /h/ or the sequence of /r/ plus a vowel ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-sakhalin-ainu-final-r-has-become-either⟧. In Karafuto dialects, a vowel is added to a syllable-final *r* to create an open syllable, often reduplicating the root vowel or matching the vowel of the Hokkaido affiliative form, as seen in pairs such as *nukara*/*nukar* and *kisaru*/*kisar* ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-karafuto-dialects-a-vowel-is-added-to⟧. In addition, /r/ in Sakhalin Ainu is described as a plosive-like retroflex [ɽ] or [t], sounding quite different from the Japanese r-sound and sometimes confused with /te/, especially in /re/ ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--r-is-a-plosive-like-retroflex-or-t⟧. In many Karafuto dialects, word-initial *r* is changed to *t* in some lexical items ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-many-karafuto-dialects-word-initial-r-is⟧, and this tendency is specifically reported for the northern Karafuto Nairo dialect and east-coast dialects such as Ōtani, where forms such as *rup*/*tup* and *ruh* are attested ⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-the-northern-karafuto-nairo-dialect-and-east⟧.
text.ja: 樺太アイヌ語は北海道アイヌ語とは異なる音節末/r/の反映形を示す。樺太アイヌ語では/r/の直後に同じ母音が実際に挿入されて開音節となり音韻的区別がなくなるが、中には+rVの形式をとらず/h/で交替することもある⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-sakhalin-ainu-the-identical-vowel-is-inserted⟧。より一般的に言えば、樺太アイヌ語では末尾の/r/は/h/または/r/に母音が後続する連続のいずれかに変化した⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-sakhalin-ainu-final-r-has-become-either⟧。樺太方言では音節末のrの後に母音が添加されて開音節を形成し、しばしば語根母音が反復されるか、北海道方言の所属形に現れる母音と同じ母音が添加され、*nukara*/*nukar*や*kisaru*/*kisar*のような対応が見られる⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-karafuto-dialects-a-vowel-is-added-to⟧。また樺太アイヌ語の/r/は破裂的な反り舌音[ɽ]・[t]として記述されており、日本語のラ行子音とはかなり異なり、特に/re/のとき/te/とまぎらわしく聞こえることがある⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--r-is-a-plosive-like-retroflex-or-t⟧。多くの樺太方言においていくつかの語彙項目で語頭のrがtに変化し⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-many-karafuto-dialects-word-initial-r-is⟧、この傾向は樺太北部の内路方言および大谷などの東海岸方言において特に報告されており、*rup*/*tup*・*ruh*などの形式が確認されている⟦claim:phon/rhotic-r--in-the-northern-karafuto-nairo-dialect-and-east⟧。
